name: JSW Utkal Steel Integrated Steel Plant, Paradip
description: JSW Utkal Steel Ltd, a JSW Steel subsidiary, began construction of a 13.2 MTPA integrated steel plant on former POSCO land near Paradip, Odisha, along with a 900MW captive power plant, a 10 MTPA cement grinding unit and a captive jetty, at a cumulative investment of ₹1.25 trillion. In-house/self-executed by JSW Steel. Construction of two blast furnaces begun simultaneously; project spans ~2,958 acres, expected to employ ~42,000.

name: Tata Steel Kalinganagar Phase II Expansion
description: Tata Steel inaugurated the Phase II expansion of its Kalinganagar plant in Odisha, raising capacity from 3 to 8 MTPA via a new blast furnace, at an investment of ₹27,000 crore. In-house/self-executed by Tata Steel. Inaugurated by Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi on May 22, 2025; new 5,870 m³ blast furnace among India's largest.

name: JSW Steel Vijayanagar Capacity Expansion (15 to 26 MTPA)
description: JSW Steel approved fresh capex of over ₹33,000 crore to expand its Vijayanagar Works in Karnataka from 15 MTPA to 26 MTPA, targeted for commissioning by FY30. In-house/self-executed by JSW Steel. Capex approved in Q1 FY27.

name: JSW Steel Dolvi Phase III Expansion
description: JSW Steel is investing approximately ₹19,125 crore to expand its Dolvi plant in Maharashtra from 10 MTPA to 15 MTPA by September 2027, adding a 5 MMTPA blast furnace, a new converter and a hybrid continuous caster. In-house/self-executed by JSW Steel.

name: Vedanta Aluminium Jharsuguda-Lanjigarh Expansion
description: Vedanta Aluminium is expanding its Jharsuguda aluminium park toward 6 MTPA smelter capacity, having completed Lanjigarh Train II which took alumina refinery capacity to 5 MTPA, backed by a committed capital programme of ₹13,226 crore. In-house/self-executed by Vedanta. FY26 growth capex of ~₹15,000 crore deployed, including Lanjigarh Train II and new BALCO smelter.

name: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India Hazira Upstream Expansion
description: AM/NS India is expanding upstream steelmaking capacity at its Hazira plant in Gujarat from 9 to 15 MTPA as part of an overall $7.7 billion investment programme; construction began in October 2022 with completion expected in H2 2026. In-house/self-executed. Overall $7.7bn programme: $5.1bn upstream (to 15 MTPA) plus $1bn downstream; INR crore figure not stated in source.

name: JK Cement Jaisalmer Greenfield Expansion
description: JK Cement's board approved a ₹4,805 crore greenfield expansion adding 7 MTPA capacity, comprising a 4 MTPA clinker unit and 3 MTPA grinding unit at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, plus two 2 MTPA split grinding units in Rajasthan and Punjab. In-house/self-executed. Board approved Aug 25, 2025; 525-acre Jaisalmer facility expected to complete by early 2027 per company statements.

name: UltraTech Cement Visakhapatnam Grinding Unit
description: UltraTech Cement is commissioning a 3.3 MTPA cement grinding unit at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, as part of its FY26-27 plan to add 29 MTPA of grey cement capacity across India. In-house/self-executed. Part of 14.1 MTPA of new capacity planned for FY26-27 across North, Central, East, West and South zones.

name: UltraTech Cement Patratu Grinding Unit
description: UltraTech Cement is setting up a 2.5 MTPA cement grinding unit at Patratu, Jharkhand, as part of its FY26-27 capacity expansion targeting 212.2 MTPA total domestic capacity. In-house/self-executed by UltraTech Cement.

name: Adani Cement Guna Grinding Unit
description: Adani Cement laid the foundation stone for a new cement grinding unit at Guna, Madhya Pradesh, with an investment of over ₹1,060 crore and planned annual capacity of 40 lakh tonnes across two phases, targeting Phase 1 commissioning by 2028. In-house/self-executed. Foundation stone laid May 10, 2026 by MP CM Mohan Yadav and Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia; Phase 1 targeted for 2028.

name: Ambuja Cement Gangavaram Port Grinding Unit
description: Ambuja Cements will build a new cement grinding unit within Adani's Gangavaram Port industrial estate in Andhra Pradesh, using slag and fly ash transported via rail and sea to reduce CO2 emissions. In-house/self-executed. Unit spans 8 hectares within Gangavaram Port's existing industrial zone.

name: Reliance Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex Battery Gigafactory
description: Reliance Industries is commissioning a 40 GWh (scalable to 100 GWh) battery gigafactory as part of its Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex in Jamnagar, Gujarat, with production due to start in 2026, within a ₹75,000 crore new-energy ecosystem investment. In-house/self-executed. Giga Complex spans ~5,000 acres/44 million sq ft and also includes solar-module and electrolyser gigafactories.

name: Tata Semiconductor Fab, Dholera SIR
description: Tata Electronics/Tata Semiconductor is building India's first semiconductor fabrication plant in the Dholera Special Investment Region, Gujarat, with an investment of around ₹91,000 crore and planned capacity of 50,000 wafers per month. In-house/self-executed. Dholera SEZ notified April 2026 as largest node under the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC); expected to generate ~21,000 jobs.
contractor: Tata Electronics / Tata Semiconductor Manufacturing Pvt Ltd
client: Tata Semiconductor Manufacturing Pvt Ltd (Tata Group)

name: AdaniConneX-Google AI Data Centre Campus, Visakhapatnam
description: AdaniConneX and Google are partnering to build India's largest AI data centre campus in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, with Google committing an investment reported at ₹87,520 crore (US$10 billion), part of a wider roadmap of up to $15 billion. AdaniConneX is a JV of Adani Enterprises and EdgeConneX; Adani Group's own portion of the investment reported at up to $5 billion; announced Feb 2026.

name: STT GDC Chennai Siruseri Data Centre Campus
description: STT GDC India launched its fourth Chennai data centre, a 45 MW AI-ready facility at its second Siruseri campus (first 7.2 MW phase now operational), as part of a ₹4,200 crore investment commitment to Tamil Nadu. In-house/self-executed. First 7.2 MW phase e-inaugurated by Tamil Nadu CM on Feb 12, 2026; full campus designed for 45 MW.
contractor: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
client: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India

name: NTT Kolkata Data Centre Campus
description: NTT is investing ₹2,000 crore in a new hyperscale data centre campus in Kolkata, West Bengal, comprising three buildings on 7.5 acres with 600,000 sq ft of floor space, part of a broader $2.5 billion India investment plan. In-house/self-executed. First-phase investment reported at ₹500 crore; groundbreaking held for the Kolkata campus.

name: NTT DATA-Neysa AI Data Centre Campus, Hyderabad
description: NTT DATA, with Neysa Networks and the Telangana government, is building a 400 MW AI data centre campus in Hyderabad featuring 25,000 GPUs, at an investment of $1.2 billion. Investment stated as $1.2 billion in source; INR crore figure not given. Developed with Telangana state government partnership.

name: Yotta D2 Data Centre GPU Supercluster, Greater Noida
description: Yotta Data Services is deploying over 20,000 liquid-cooled NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs at its 60 MW D2 data centre in Greater Noida (scalable to 250 MW), an investment exceeding $2 billion, expected to go live by August 2026. In-house/self-executed. Investment stated as exceeding $2 billion (INR crore figure not given); four-year NVIDIA engagement over $1 billion; additional capacity planned at Navi Mumbai campus, scalable to 2GW.

name: IndoSpace Bhiwandi Logistics Park
description: IndoSpace is investing $57 million to develop a 66-acre logistics park with over 1.7 million sq ft of development potential in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, adding to over $330 million it has already invested in the state. In-house/self-executed. Investment stated as $57 million in source (INR crore figure not given); phase-wise operations to begin within the financial year.

name: ESR Hosur Advanced Manufacturing Park
description: ESR India acquired 85 acres in Hosur, Tamil Nadu, to develop the ESR Hosur Advanced Manufacturing Park, a ₹600 crore, 2.1 million sq ft Grade A+ industrial campus targeting manufacturing, electronics, EV and aerospace tenants. In-house/self-executed. Announced Nov 10, 2025; 10 buildings planned within the Hosur–Shoolagiri industrial belt.

name: Chennai Multi-Modal Logistics Park, Mappedu
description: Reliance Industries is developing India's first Multi-Modal Logistics Park at Mappedu near Chennai on a 45-year PPP concession awarded by the government, spanning 184.27 acres at an estimated project cost of ₹1,424 crore. Awarded to Reliance Industries in 2022 outbidding Adani Group; foundation stone laid by PM Modi on May 26, 2022; projected to handle ~7.17 million tonnes of cargo over the concession period.

name: Bengaluru Multi-Modal Logistics Park, Obalapura
description: South India's largest Multi-Modal Logistics Park is being developed at Obalapura, Nelamangala taluk near Bengaluru, spanning 406 acres at a cost of ₹1,770 crore, with Phase 1 completion expected in 2026. Covers 406 acres including common road; Phase 1 completion targeted for 2026 per government sources.
contractor: PATH Bengaluru Logistics Park Private Limited

name: DP World Tuna-Tekra Mega Container Terminal, Kandla
description: DP World, through its JV Hindustan Infralog Private Limited (with NIIF), is developing the ₹4,243.64 crore Tuna-Tekra mega-container terminal near Deendayal Port, Kandla, Gujarat, on a 30-year BOT concession, targeted for completion in 2027. 2.19 million TEU terminal with 1,100m berth capable of handling 18,000 TEU vessels; BOT concession for 30 years, extendable by 20; also reported as ~$510 million.
contractor: DP World / Hindustan Infralog Private Limited

name: Thane Integral Ring Metro Rail Project – Contract C-01
description: Maha Metro issued a Letter of Acceptance to a Kalpataru Projects-HG Infra Engineering JV for design and construction of a 20.527 km elevated metro viaduct between the UG ramp and Balkum Naka, plus depot approach viaduct and three special spans. LOA issued 10 December 2025; part of the Rs 12,200 crore Thane Integral Ring Metro Project approved by the Central Cabinet in August 2024.
contractor: Kalpataru Projects International Ltd - HG Infra Engineering Ltd (JV)
client: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (Maha Metro)

name: Jaipur Metro Phase 2 – Elevated Corridor Civil Contract
description: A Ceigall India-SAM India Builtwell JV secured an EPC/item-rate contract to build a 10.8 km elevated viaduct with ten stations, including a spur line to the depot, for Jaipur Metro Phase-2. Ceigall holds a 74% stake in the JV; 34-month execution timeline.
contractor: Ceigall India Ltd - SAM India Builtwell (JV)

name: Delhi Metro Phase 4 – Package D2C-02 (Golden Line, Saket G-Block–Lajpat Nagar)
description: RVNL was awarded a civil contract to build a 7.298 km viaduct and platform-level works for 7 elevated stations on Delhi Metro's Golden Line. First contract package for Delhi Metro Line-11, part of the 112.32 km Phase 4 project approved in March 2024.

name: Delhi Metro Phase 4 – Package DC-09 Tunnel (Aerocity–Tughlakabad)
description: Larsen & Toubro emerged as the lowest bidder for the underground tunnelling civil contract package DC-09 on the Aerocity-Tughlakabad (Golden Line) corridor of Delhi Metro Phase 4.

name: Agra Metro Phase 1 Line-2 – Package AGCC-07
description: L&T won the civil construction contract for the 15.09 km Line-2 of Agra Metro Phase 1, covering the entire line's viaduct, 14 elevated stations, and viaduct links to the Kalindi Vihar and PAC depots. L&T declared L1 bidder 13 August 2024; contract awarded in September 2024 (exact date not stated).

name: Kochi Metro Phase 2 – Main Construction Contract
description: Afcons Infrastructure was awarded a construction contract for Kochi Metro Phase 2, part of a project co-financed by AIIB, with a tight 600-day design-and-build deadline. Awarded June 2024; AIIB has approved financing for Kochi Metro Rail Project Phase II.

name: Nagpur Metro Phase 2 – Elevated Viaduct (3 Reaches)
description: Kalpataru Projects International was awarded a contract to design and construct elevated metro viaducts across three reaches spanning 17.65 km of Nagpur Metro Phase 2. Awarded January 2025 (exact day not stated).
client: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (Maha Metro)

name: Nagpur Metro Phase 2 – Package C-09 (Orange Line Reach-1A Stations)
description: A YFC Projects-BBG Infra JV won a civil contract to construct eight elevated stations on the Orange Line's Reach-1A segment of Nagpur Metro Phase 2, part of the 43.8 km Phase 2 expansion. Awarded January 2025 (exact day not stated).
client: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (Maha Metro)

name: Indore Metro Yellow Line – Package IN-05R (Underground Section)
description: An HCC-Tata Projects JV was awarded the construction contract for the underground section of Indore Metro's Yellow Line by MPMRCL.
contractor: Hindustan Construction Company Ltd - Tata Projects Ltd (JV)
client: Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (MPMRCL)

name: Indore Metro Rail Project – Civil Contract (RVNL-URC JV)
description: An RVNL-URC JV was awarded a civil construction contract for the Indore Metro Rail Project by MPMRCL.
client: Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (MPMRCL)

name: Kolkata Metro Line 4 – Biman Bandar–Birati Underground Extension
description: ITD Cementation was declared lowest bidder for civil construction of the 6.87 km underground extension of Kolkata Metro Line-4 from Kolkata Airport to Birati, including a 3.59 km tunnel and an underground station at Birati. Declared L1 bidder 25 June 2025; original estimate was Rs 1,330.47 crore with a 910-day (~30-month) deadline.
client: Metro Railway Kolkata / Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation

name: Kolkata Metro Line 4 – Underground Civil Contracts (Senbo Engineering)
description: Senbo Engineering won underground civil construction contracts for Kolkata Metro Line 4.
client: Metro Railway Kolkata / Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation

name: Surat Metro Rail Project Phase-1 – Civil Contract (Dilip Buildcon)
description: Dilip Buildcon executed a civil construction contract agreement with GMRC for the Surat Metro Rail Project Phase-1. As of March 2025, Surat Metro Phase-1 was 57.20% complete and targeted for October 2025 completion.

name: Ahmedabad Metro Phase 2 – Civil Contract (Dilip Buildcon)
description: Dilip Buildcon was declared lowest bidder for Phase-2 of Ahmedabad Metro, covering construction of a 7.553 km elevated viaduct and 7 stations from Sector-1 to Mahatma Mandir. GMRC has since floated further Phase 2A/2B civil tenders indicating the Phase 2 corridor remains under active construction.

name: Patna Metro Phase 1 – Package PC-05 (Underground Corridor)
description: HCC won a contract to design and construct twin tunnels via shield TBM, a cut-and-cover tunnel, an underground ramp at Mithapur, and three metro stations on Patna Metro's underground corridor. Awarded together with Package PC-06 for a combined Rs 2,566 crore covering the 10.67 km underground Danapur-Khemnichak corridor.

name: Patna Metro Phase 1 – Package PC-06 (Underground Corridor)
description: HCC won a second contract covering an underground ramp at Rukanpura and three metro stations, including architectural finishing and utility works, on Patna Metro's underground corridor. Awarded together with Package PC-05 for a combined Rs 2,566 crore covering the 10.67 km underground Danapur-Khemnichak corridor.

name: Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension – Civil Contract
description: NMRC awarded L&T the civil construction contract for two Aqua Line extensions, the larger being a 12.5 km, Rs 2,254.35 crore corridor from Botanical Garden to Sector 142. Contract period is 1,096 days; L&T selected among nine bidders after the tender was re-floated twice.

name: Lucknow Metro Phase 1B – East-West Corridor (Thakurganj–Vasantkunj)
description: UPMRC awarded Ranjit Buildcon the civil construction contract for a 4.6 km elevated section of Lucknow Metro's East-West Corridor with five new stations. Value is approximately Rs 384 crore excluding GST; part of the Rs 5,801 crore Lucknow Metro East-West Corridor project.

name: Mumbai Metro Line 2B – Architectural Finishing Package
description: MMRDA awarded a DEV-N.ROSE JV a contract for architectural finishing works and station infrastructure at seven elevated stations on Mumbai Metro Line 2B (D.N. Nagar–Mandale corridor).

name: Chennai Metro Phase 2 – Sholinganallur & Thoraipakkam Entry/Exit and TOD
description: CMRL awarded Bridge and Roof Company (India) a contract for design and construction of integrated metro station entry/exit structures with commercial transit-oriented development at Sholinganallur and Thoraipakkam stations. Technical bids opened 29 July 2025, financial evaluation completed 31 October 2025; contract to be executed within 550 days of the Letter of Award.

name: Pune-Shirur 6-Lane Highway (NH-753F)
description: Construction of a 6-lane (including partially elevated) highway corridor from Pune to Shirur spanning a minimum design length of 53.40 km, awarded as an item-rate domestic contract. Letter of Award from Welspun Enterprises Limited; boosts HG Infra's order book into a higher tier of EPC awards.

name: Kozhikode-Wayanad Twin Tube Tunnel (Anakkampoyil-Kalladi-Meppadi)
description: EPC contract for an 8.275 km twin-tube unidirectional road tunnel with a 4-lane approach road connecting Anakkampoyil (Kozhikode) to Kalladi and Meppadi (Wayanad). KRCL is the implementing agency for this Kerala road-tunnel project, not a rail project.

name: Buxar-Bharauli Ganga Bridge (NH-922)
description: Construction of an additional 3-lane bridge over the river Ganga connecting Buxar (Bihar) and Bharauli (Uttar Pradesh) on NH-922, awarded on Hybrid Annuity Mode. 910-day construction period plus 15-year O&M under HAM; connects UP and Bihar across the Ganga.

name: Guwahati Ring Road
description: 121 km Guwahati Ring Road project awarded on a Build-Operate-Toll (BOT, zero grant) basis under a 30-year concession including a 4-year construction period, aimed at decongesting Guwahati traffic. Concession agreement signed April 5, 2025; zero-grant BOT toll model.
contractor: Dineshchandra R Agrawal Infracon Pvt Ltd (DRA Infracon)

name: Majuli-Jorhat Bridge (balance works)
description: Long-stalled bridge over the Brahmaputra connecting Majuli island and Jorhat received a fresh Letter of Acceptance for completion of the remaining main-bridge works after the earlier contractor halted work in September 2024. New contractor appointed after previous contractor (UP State Bridge Corporation Ltd) abandoned work; bid excludes GST.
client: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

name: Visakhapatnam Port Road Connectivity (NH-516C)
description: Construction of six-lane connectivity (12.66 km main road including a 1.596 km elevated section, plus 22.26 km service roads and 93 structures) from Sabbavaram bypass to Sheelanagar junction, linking Visakhapatnam Port. RVNL, a Railways-Ministry PSU, diversifying into NHAI road-construction contracts; 15-year O&M period follows construction.

name: Bowaichandi-Guskara Katwa Economic Corridor (NH-116A, Package-3)
description: Development of a 4-lane economic corridor from Bowaichandi to Guskara-Katwa road section of NH-116A in West Bengal, awarded under the Hybrid Annuity Model. Awarded alongside a companion Kharagpur-Chandrakona Ghatal package that NHAI later cancelled for administrative reasons.

name: Paramakudi-Ramanathapuram Four-Laning (NH-49/NH-87)
description: Four-laning of the 46.47 km Paramakudi to Ramanathapuram section of NH-49 (new NH-87) under the Hybrid Annuity Model, with a 24-month construction period followed by 15 years of O&M. L-1 bid announced via BSE/NSE filing dated October 27, 2025.

name: Gudebellur-Mahabubnagar Four-Laning (NH-167)
description: Four-laning of the Gudebellur to Mahabubnagar section of NH-167 in Telangana under a Concession Agreement on the Hybrid Annuity Model, with a 730-day construction period and 15-year O&M. Part of the Hyderabad-Panaji economic corridor; LOA received by KNR's SPV subsidiary.
contractor: KNR Constructions Ltd (via subsidiary KNR Manyamkonda Infra Pvt Ltd)

name: Ganga Path EPC (Sultanganj-Bhagalpur-Sabour Road)
description: 41 km EPC road project connecting Sultanganj, Bhagalpur and Sabour, awarded to be completed over 42 months. Adani Road Transport Ltd is the concessionaire/employer; Dilip Buildcon is the EPC contractor.
client: Adani Road Transport Ltd (ARTL), on behalf of Bihar State Road Development Corporation (BSRDC)

name: Agra-Gwalior Greenfield Expressway
description: Development of a six-lane, access-controlled greenfield highway connecting Deori village (Agra) to Susera village (Gwalior), crossing Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, restructured into a single-package EPC contract. Route spans three states (UP, Rajasthan, MP); overlaying and safety enhancement of the existing NH-44 Agra-Gwalior section.

name: Zoji La Tunnel
description: 14.15 km single-tube, bi-directional highway tunnel under the Zoji La pass on the Srinagar-Leh highway (NH-1), intended to provide all-weather connectivity between Kashmir and Ladakh; MoRTH reported roughly 64-70% completion as of 2025. Cited project cost varies widely across sources (roughly Rs 4,500-8,300 crore depending on scope/phase counted), so left null for accuracy; tunnel breakthrough was targeted for June 2026.
client: National Highways & Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd (NHIDCL)

name: Nashri-Chenani Upgradation (NH-244 via Patnitop)
description: Upgradation and strengthening of the Nashri-Chenani section of NH-244 via Patnitop in Jammu and Kashmir, awarded as an EPC project with a 24-month completion period. 24-month construction window from mid-2024 places the project near its scheduled completion by mid-2026.

name: Nagpur-Chandrapur Access-Controlled Super Communication Expressway (two packages)
description: Construction of sections of the Nagpur-Chandrapur access-controlled expressway across two MSRDC tenders on EPC mode, with a combined bid value of Rs 4,142.22 crore. HG Infra emerged as L-1 bidder for both packages simultaneously.

name: Gandak and Mahi Bridge Rehabilitation with New Gandak Bridge (NH-19, Chappara-Hajipur section)
description: EPC contract to execute balance work on a new bridge over the Gandak river (with approach roads) and to rehabilitate the existing Gandak and Mahi bridges on the Chappara-Hajipur section of NH-19 in Bihar. Smaller-value balance/rehabilitation contract distinct from the separate, larger Bihar-government Gandak Bridge project at Muzaffarpur.

name: Vadhavan Port – Near-Shore Reclamation & Shore Protection
description: EPC contract for near-shore reclamation and shore protection works at the greenfield Vadhavan Port, awarded to ITD Cementation India at a price 6.89% below the estimated cost. Bid price ₹1,648 cr vs estimated cost ₹1,770 cr; LOA dated around Dec 31, 2024/Jan 1, 2025.
client: Vadhavan Port Project Ltd (VPPL, JV of JNPA & Maharashtra Maritime Board)

name: Deendayal (Kandla) Port – Berth No. 13 Multipurpose Cargo Berth
description: Development of a 300m multipurpose clean-cargo berth (5.7 MMTPA capacity) at Deendayal Port under a 30-year DBFOT concession. LOI received July 2024; likely commissioning in FY27.
contractor: Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ)

name: NTPC Darlipali Supercritical TPP Stage-II (800 MW)
description: EPC contract for the 1x800 MW Darlipali Supercritical Thermal Power Project Stage-II in Sundargarh district, covering design, equipment supply, erection and commissioning. Notification of Award received Nov 6, 2025; value excludes GST.

name: NTPC Sipat Supercritical TPP Stage-III (800 MW)
description: EPC package for the 1x800 MW Sipat Supercritical Thermal Power Project Stage-III using ultra-supercritical technology; PM laid the foundation stone in March 2025. Foundation stone laid by PM on March 30, 2025.

name: NTPC Lara Stage-III Thermal Power Project (2x800 MW)
description: Main plant package (BTG) for a 2x800 MW ultra-supercritical thermal power project at Lara, awarded to L&T's Energy CarbonLite Solutions business under a Limited Notice to Proceed. L&T classifies the order as "Mega" (₹5,000–10,000 cr category); exact value undisclosed.

name: NTPC Barauni Thermal Station – Battery Energy Storage System (1 GWh)
description: EPC contract for a 1 GWh Battery Energy Storage System at NTPC's Barauni Thermal Power Station, awarded under NTPC's 2.67 GWh BESS tender. Part of a wider NTPC BESS tender; a separate 570 MWh BESS package went to Pratap.

name: Khavda Renewable Energy Park – Solar BOS Package
description: Balance-of-System EPC contract covering three solar power projects (~1 GW) at the Khavda Renewable Energy Park, part of a larger multi-GW build-out for Adani Green. Sterling & Wilson is working on 6 GW of projects at Khavda overall, with 5 GW targeted within FY.

name: NTPC REL Chitrakoot-1 Solar Project (400 MW AC)
description: EPC contract on a balance-of-system basis for a 400 MW AC grid-connected solar project at the Chitrakoot solar park, developed under TUSCO's solar park scheme. Part of NTPC REL's 1.4 GW UP solar BOS awards also involving Sterling & Wilson, Bondada, Kintech.

name: Paradip Port – Multi-Purpose Berth Mechanisation (8 MTPA)
description: 30-year BOT concession to mechanise a multi-purpose berth with 8 MTPA capacity at Paradip Port, part of the port authority's plan for 100% berth mechanisation by 2030. Signed alongside two other Paradip mechanisation concessions (South Quay – Yogayatan ₹498.69 cr; CQ-III captive – AMNS Paradip Logistics ₹451 cr) totaling ₹1,580.36 cr.

name: VOC Port Tuticorin – Outer Harbour Development
description: Global HAM tender for construction of a breakwater, rock bund, wharf, and capital dredging/reclamation for an outer harbour and backup yard at V.O. Chidambaranar Port. Bid documents on sale Dec 26, 2025 to Feb 6, 2026.

name: Barnar Reservoir Scheme, Jamui
description: Construction of the Barnar reservoir and dam structures, irrigation channels and associated works, reviving a scheme first sanctioned in 1975, to improve irrigation reliability in the region. 30-month construction period followed by a 60-month defect liability period.
client: Water Resources Department, Government of Bihar

name: Ken-Betwa Link Project – Daudhan Dam
description: EPC execution of the 77-metre-high, ~2.1 km-long Daudhan Dam on the Ken river inside Panna Tiger Reserve, the core structure of the Ken-Betwa river-linking project for the Bundelkhand region. Foundation laid by PM on Dec 25, 2024; civil construction began around September 2025.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission – Dholpur-Saipau Water Supply Project
description: Bulk water supply infrastructure drawing from the Chambal river, including an intake well, two large raw water reservoirs, 712 km of pipelines and 21 elevated service reservoirs, to serve over 1.5 million residents. 20-month EPC phase, plus 1-year defect liability and 10-year O&M.
contractor: SPML Infra Ltd (JV with JWIL Infra Ltd, 51% lead)
client: Public Health Engineering Department (PHED), Government of Rajasthan

name: Kondhane Dam Project
description: Construction of the Kondhane Dam (1,209m long, 83m high) using Roller Compacted Concrete technology, along with allied infrastructure, in Raigad district. Patel Engineering emerged lowest bidder May 1, 2025; 42-month project period from commencement.
client: City and Industrial Development Corporation of Maharashtra Ltd (CIDCO)

name: Visakhapatnam Port – Green Tug Manning, Operation & Maintenance
description: 15-year contract to man, operate, maintain and provide complete technical management of an ASTDS GTTP Green Tug for Visakhapatnam Port Authority. KMEW's second such green tug order from VPA; value inclusive of taxes over a 15-year term.

name: Bhogapuram (Alluri Sitarama Raju) International Airport
description: Greenfield international airport near Visakhapatnam; GMR Group confirmed construction is progressing ahead of schedule, with completion expected before the December 2026 deadline. L&T's civil construction contract (awarded Nov 2023) reported in an undisclosed value range of roughly ₹2,500–5,000 cr; overall airport cost cited elsewhere as ~$500 million.
client: GMR Group (Bhogapuram Airport concession, with Andhra Pradesh Government)

name: Noida International Airport (Jewar) – Phase 1
description: Greenfield international airport at Jewar; Phase 1 construction, including runway, terminal and fuel farm, neared completion with test flights conducted in late 2025 ahead of PM inauguration. PM Modi scheduled to inaugurate Phase 1 in late March 2026; commercial flight operations to follow.

name: Sagardighi Thermal Power Plant – FGD Retrofit
description: EPC order for wet Flue Gas Desulphurization (FGD) systems covering four thermal units (2x300 MW, 2x500 MW) at Sagardighi Thermal Power Plant, L&T's first FGD project for a state power utility. Order value described as "up to" ₹2,500 cr; three FGD absorbers serving five units in total.
client: West Bengal Power Development Corporation Ltd (WBPDCL)

name: Tamil Nadu Transmission Line Upgrade (RTM)
description: Two transmission projects to upgrade existing transmission lines in Tamil Nadu, awarded to POWERGRID under the Regulated Tariff Mechanism framework. Estimated total cost over ₹1,800 cr for the two upgrade projects.
contractor: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID)
client: Ministry of Power, Government of India (RTM/CEA-approved)

name: Jam Khambhaliya REZ Phase-II / Jamnagar Phase-I Transmission Project
description: Inter-state transmission system project to evacuate renewable power from the Jam Khambhaliya Renewable Energy Zone Phase-II and Jamnagar Phase-I, won by POWERGRID via competitive bidding. Awarded on tariff basis at ₹822.91 crore per annum; project evacuates power from a zone integrating 6,500 MW of Gujarat renewables. LOI received Aug 21, 2026.
contractor: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID)
client: Central Transmission Utility of India Ltd (CTUIL, tariff-based competitive bidding)

name: AIIMS Madurai Phase I (Hospital, Medical College & Nursing College)
description: Construction of a 720-bed teaching hospital, 150-bed Infectious Diseases Block, 30-bed AYUSH block, medical college, nursing college, auditorium and hostels for AIIMS Madurai. Total Phase I project cost is Rs 2021.51 crore; the construction contract awarded to L&T within this is reported at Rs 1,118.35 crore.
client: AIIMS Madurai / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: AIIMS Rewari
description: New AIIMS campus in Rewari, Haryana comprising a 720-bed teaching hospital, 30-bed AYUSH hospital, medical college, nursing college, auditorium, hostel and residential facilities, awarded to L&T's Health Business Unit on an EPC basis. Construction has commenced; one source cites a 22-month contractual period while another cites overall completion expected in about 3 years.
contractor: Larsen & Toubro (L&T Construction – Health Business Unit)
client: AIIMS Rewari / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Max Super Speciality Hospital Mohali – Expansion
description: EPC expansion of Max Super Speciality Hospital at SAS Nagar, Mohali, raising bed capacity from 231 to 400 beds. Order announced September 2023; Ahluwalia's EPC order value is Rs 215.46 crore against a stated total hospital investment of close to Rs 400 crore.

name: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Sector-56, Gurugram
description: New-build Max Super Speciality Hospital at Sector-56, Gurugram, awarded to Ahluwalia Contracts on an EPC basis as part of Max Healthcare's NCR expansion. Order announced September 2023 alongside the Mohali expansion order.

name: ESIC 500-Bed Hospital, Manesar
description: Construction of a new 500-bed ESIC hospital at Manesar (Gurugram), Haryana, awarded to HSCC (India) Ltd, a subsidiary of state-owned NBCC, on a deposit-mode work order basis. Part of a combined Rs 1,322.48 crore work order package from ESIC to HSCC disclosed on 22 October 2024.

name: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad – Bed Expansion
description: Expansion of ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Faridabad, adding 500 additional beds and raising total capacity from 650 to 1,150 beds, awarded to HSCC (India) Ltd on a deposit-mode basis. Announced together with the Manesar ESIC hospital order.

name: Government Medical College & Hospital, Buldhana
description: Construction of a new 100-seat government medical college and 430-bed hospital at Buldhana, Maharashtra, awarded to HSCC (India) Ltd by the state's Directorate of Medical Education and Ayush. Contract announced in July 2024.
client: Directorate of Medical Education and Ayush, Government of Maharashtra

name: Vishram Gruh, Asarva Civil Hospital Campus
description: Development of a Vishram Gruh (patient rest-house facility) at the Asarva Civil Hospital campus in Ahmedabad, awarded to PSP Projects with a 20-month execution timeline. Contract value reported as Rs 510 million (~Rs 51 crore).

name: Dharavi Redevelopment Project
description: Redevelopment of Asia's largest slum, Dharavi, into a mixed-use township with in-situ rehabilitation housing for eligible slum dwellers and market-rate development on freed-up land. Rs 5,069 crore is Adani Properties' winning bid value (Nov 2022); construction on railway land began Jan 2025.
contractor: Adani Properties Pvt Ltd (Dharavi Redevelopment Project Pvt Ltd)
client: Government of Maharashtra / Slum Rehabilitation Authority

name: NAINA Integrated Infrastructure Development, TPS-8/9/12
description: Integrated infrastructure development (roads, flyovers, minor bridges, underpasses, street-light electrical works) across Town Planning Schemes 8, 9 and 12 under the Navi Mumbai Airport Influence Notified Area (NAINA). LOA issued 11 October 2024; completion timeline is 1,460 days (~48 months).
contractor: PNC Infratech Ltd (JV with Aakshya Infra Projects Pvt Ltd)
client: City and Industrial Development Corporation of Maharashtra Ltd (CIDCO)

name: Palakkad Industrial Smart City Infrastructure (Kochi–Bengaluru Industrial Corridor)
description: Infrastructure development across 1,450 acres for the Palakkad Industrial Smart City — the first node of the Kochi-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor — covering roads, bridges, drainage, water supply, power distribution, sewage treatment and industrial effluent systems. Centre had earlier released Rs 300 crore for the project; total project estimate is around Rs 3,600 crore.
contractor: Dilip Buildcon Ltd & PSP Projects Ltd (JV)
client: Kerala Industrial Corridor Development Corporation (KICDC) / Palakkad Smart City

name: Amaravati Capital City – Base Infrastructure
description: Construction of base infrastructure for Andhra Pradesh's greenfield capital city Amaravati — roads, bridges, stormwater drains, sewerage, and power/ICT utility ducts. Amaravati capital construction resumed at scale from 2024; L&T separately awarded the Rs 617 crore new Assembly Building contract (construction began 2 May 2025).
client: Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA)

name: Varanasi Urban Ropeway (Kashi Ropeway)
description: India's first urban ropeway, a 3.75 km, 30-tower cable-car transit line connecting Varanasi Cantonment railway station to Kashi Vidyapeeth/Godowlia near Kashi Vishwanath Temple, built on a hybrid annuity PPP model. Civil work began in 2023 with an 18-month construction target; executed by NHLML under the hybrid annuity model.
contractor: Vishwa Samudra Engineering Pvt Ltd (with Bartholet Maschinenbau AG, Switzerland)

name: Godrej Samaris
description: Ultra-luxury residential development by Godrej Properties on Golf Course Road, Sector 53, Gurugram, spread over 7.41 acres with 5 towers (G+36) delivering 488 apartments in 3/4 BHK configurations. Core and shell construction awarded to Tata Projects as part of a combined ~₹1,100 Cr contract covering Godrej Sora, Astra and Samaris.

name: Godrej Astra
description: Premium gated residential project by Godrej Properties on Golf Course Road, Sector 54, Gurugram, spanning 2.76 acres with 2 towers (G+28 to G+35) offering 151 luxury 3/4 BHK residences. Part of combined ~₹1,100 Cr core & shell contract awarded to Tata Projects covering Godrej Sora, Astra and Samaris.

name: Godrej Sora
description: Japanese-themed luxury residential project by Godrej Properties on Golf Course Road, Sector 53, Gurugram, spread over about 3.7 acres with 4 towers (up to G+30) delivering around 244 units. Part of combined ~₹1,100 Cr core & shell contract awarded to Tata Projects covering Godrej Sora, Astra and Samaris.

name: Godrej Properties Kandivali East Residential Development (6 towers)
description: Six 44-storey residential towers being built by Godrej Properties on a 7.2-hectare site in Kandivali East, Mumbai, with a total floor area of nearly 500,000 sq. m. Contract awarded to Leighton Asia around April 2025.

name: Sarvam at DXP Estate
description: Residential project by Signature Global at Sector 37D, Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram, comprising 11 towers with 1,798 units across roughly 5 million sq. ft.; construction split between two contractors. ₹920 Cr is the combined construction contract value: KEC (₹460 Cr, 6 towers) and NCC (₹460 Cr, 5 towers).
contractor: KEC International Limited & NCC Limited (split contract)

name: Urban Resort
description: Residential project comprising seven towers at Sector 103, Gurugram, developed by Whiteland Corporation, with core construction contracted to Ahluwalia Contracts. Order value excludes GST; disclosed via BSE/NSE regulatory filing dated June 27, 2025.

name: Powai Heights
description: Luxury residential complex of three high-end towers in Chandivali, Mumbai, developed by Sumer Corporation under an EPC contract with Garuda Construction and Engineering. EPC order disclosed via NSE regulatory filing.

name: Oberoi Garden City Thane
description: 75-acre integrated residential township by Oberoi Realty in Thane (MMR); first phase comprises 5 residential towers (up to 65 storeys), plus a planned JW Marriott hotel and Oberoi International School. ₹1,348 Cr is gross booking value achieved in the first 3 days of launch, not stated construction cost. Developer self-executes.

name: Brigade Eternia
description: Residential project by Brigade Enterprises in Yelahanka, Bengaluru, spread over 14.65 acres with 1,124 units and about 20 lakh sq. ft. built-up area. ₹2,700 Cr is stated revenue potential, not construction contract value. Developer self-executes.

name: DLF The Dahlias
description: Ultra-luxury residential development by DLF on Golf Course Road, Sector 54, Gurugram; 9 towers on about 17 acres with roughly 421 residences, RERA registered October 2024, possession targeted December 2030. RERA registration GGM/872/604/2024/99 dated 04.10.2024. Developer self-executes.

name: DLF Senior Living, Gurugram
description: DLF's entry into the senior-living residential segment with a new project launch in Gurugram, with stated revenue potential of around ₹2,000 Cr. Specific sector/plot location and exact launch date not confirmed in source; developer self-executes.

name: Treetopia
description: Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate's entry into plotted development: a 105-acre plotted housing project in Pune with 483 residential plots and an estimated revenue potential of ₹600 Cr. ₹600 Cr is stated revenue potential. Developer self-executes.

name: Vyomora
description: Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate's third residential project in the Hinjawadi belt of Pune, spread across approximately 25 acres, launched July 2026. Developer self-executes; contractor not separately named in source.

name: Tata Intellion Park, Ghansoli
description: Large mixed-use IT/commercial development by Tata Realty and Infrastructure near Reliance Corporate Park, Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai, spread across 47.11 acres with cumulative construction area of about 15.17 million sq. ft. Construction reported to have commenced in 2023 with multi-phase completion planned by around 2030; developer self-executes.

name: Navi Mumbai Airport Township, Panvel
description: Adani Realty's large-scale township development spanning over 1,000 acres near the upcoming Navi Mumbai International Airport in Panvel, featuring plots, villas and 4,000+ apartments. Adani's largest real estate development to date; developer self-executes.

name: Birla Arika Phase 2
description: Luxury residential project (Phase 2) by Birla Estates in Gurugram; achieved gross bookings of over ₹1,600 Cr within a month of launch, with 152 of 156 units sold. ₹1,600 Cr figure is gross sales bookings, not construction contract value. Developer self-executes.

name: Casagrand Ventra
description: Premium high-rise residential community launched by Casagrand in Kattupakkam on Poonamallee High Road, West Chennai; spans 3.5 acres with 279 apartments/floor villas across B+S+20 floors. Launched April 2026; price range reported as ₹85 Lakh to ₹2.97 Cr. Developer self-executes.

name: Intellion Park, Gurugram
description: Grade A office campus developed by Tata Realty and Infrastructure in Gurugram, offering about 2.1 million sq. ft. of sustainable commercial office space. TRIL took a ₹1,280 Cr loan from DBS Bank India for this project (financing amount, not stated as total project cost). Developer self-executes.
